get.summary:
Gets a list of full samples.
A maximum of 1000 sample ids are allowed.

parameters.name: sampleids
parameters.description:
A comma-separated list of MVM sample Ids.
            Maximum 1000 sample Ids are allowed.

200.description: Returns a list of sample objects.

get.summary:
Gets a list of full samples using a dynamic query filter.
All query params are optional but at least one must be specified.

parameters.name: stationIds
parameters.description: Optional. A comma separated list of station ids

parameters.name: nationalStationIds
parameters.description: Optional. A comma separated List of national station ids

parameters.name: productType
parameters.description: Optional. A product type: Biology or Chemistry.

parameters.name: study
parameters.description: Optional. A study name, in the format delprogram+space+undersökning.

parameters.name: updatedSince
parameters.description: Optional. Only retrieve data that's been updated since this date.

200.description: Returns a list of sample objects.

400.description: Invalid input parameters. The request may be too large.
